<?php
class QuietBoolRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): bool { echo "G;"; return "0"; }
}
function quietBoolRhs(): bool { echo "RHS;"; return true; }
$receiver = new QuietBoolRead;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietBoolRhs()) === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietBoolRhs()) === true ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo $selector === "zero" ? "NAME;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietTrueRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "TI;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): true { echo "TG;"; return true; }
}
class QuietFalseAssign {
    private bool $value = true;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "FI;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): false { echo "FG;"; return false; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
}
function quietLiteralRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$positive = new QuietTrueRead;
echo empty($positive->value) ? "BAD;" : "NONEMPTY;";
$negative = new QuietFalseAssign;
echo ($negative->value ??= quietLiteralRhs()) === false ? "KEEP_FALSE;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
